# Adonias Nigussie

> Marketing operations and growth manager based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, who builds lead generation systems, funnels, outbound, and paid media for tech and SaaS companies, and uses AI to automate what needs automating. Experience across Estonia, the UK, Italy, and Ethiopia. Specialties: marketing and business strategy, SEO and content, paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok), AI-driven marketing systems, and five years of Meta ads. Open to roles locally and internationally, plus freelance and consulting.

Key verified results: grew a multi-product SaaS portfolio to roughly $22K monthly recurring revenue and landed a €10,000 enterprise deal (Pairing.dev, Estonia); a roughly 300% lead-generation lift for Palm Real Estate and a roadside-assistance startup launched from zero (Eagle Eye Business Group, Feb 2025 to Apr 2026); a B2B product scaled from 100 to 500 customers in 12 months, and two in-house products grown to 70,000 followers across 4 platforms (Jaktech); top-3 Google rankings for 14 keywords via vertical SEO for Electric Car Chargers UK (Recognise Design); an automated pipeline sourcing and qualifying 1,500+ leads a week; ~70% campaign execution time cut via AI workflows (Claude, ChatGPT).
